# `dotnet_sort_system_directives_first`

Put System.* usings before all others.

## Values

| Value | Notes |
|---|---|
| `true` |  |
| `false` |  |

**Default:** `false`

## Examples

The snippet below is formatted with default options and then again with the option applied.

**Snippet (formatted with defaults):**

```csharp
using System;
using Foo.Bar;
using System.Collections.Generic;

namespace N;

public class Widget { }
```

### `dotnet_sort_system_directives_first = true`

```ini
dotnet_sort_system_directives_first = true
```

```csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Foo.Bar;

namespace N;

public class Widget { }
```

### `dotnet_sort_system_directives_first = false`

```ini
dotnet_sort_system_directives_first = false
```

*No visible change on this snippet — the option affects other constructs.*
